item.text: I’m locating the relevant filing text in the reconstructed JSON and will extract the registrant’s telephone number directly from the document.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m reading the JSON directly and searching the text records for the telephone line.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts'] if isinstance(data,dict) and 'texts' in data else data
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    text=t.get('text','') if isinstance(t,dict) else str(t)
    if re.search(r'telephone|registrant|phone|\\(.*\\)\\s*\\d{3}[-.]\\d{4}', text, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',text[:500].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
